title: Typed Direct Groundwater Interface, Datum, Sign, Units & Convergence Policy

live_canonical_at_closeout_precheck.admission_rule: Do not directly assume mergeability. A separate F-CI admission must recompose/replay F-GC17 on then-current canonical.

qualified_contract.time: finite generic [t0,t1], T1>T0, no calendar semantics
qualified_contract.head_quantities: H_SWAP and H_GW are hydraulic heads in m on one explicit common datum
qualified_contract.swap_mode5_native_head: lower-boundary face pressure head psi_bottom in cm
qualified_contract.datum: mandatory available datum_id plus finite lower-boundary elevation z_bottom_m
qualified_contract.native_bottom_flux: SWAP qbot in cm/day, positive into SWAP soil profile
qualified_contract.public_swap_flux: q_SWAP in m/s, positive leaving SWAP
qualified_contract.head_policy: explicit finite positive H_interface_tol with externally governed qualified provenance; no numeric default

gates: exact q_GW=-q_SWAP and zero flux residual

scientific_correction.finding: A production direct-coupling interface may not equate SWAP lower-boundary pressure head numerically with groundwater hydraulic head after unit conversion alone.
scientific_correction.qualified_replacement: Use the explicit common-datum mapping H_SWAP=z_bottom+psi_bottom.
scientific_correction.effect_on_old_F_GC02: The old harness remains historical coupling-seam evidence, not production datum-contract authority. No closed production admission is reopened because F-GC02 itself was never production-admitted.

downstream.next_gate: separate F-CI canonical admission/recomposition for F-GC17
